text:
maria: Heads up — I pulled this morning's hosted vs committed run rate and there's a ~32% tilt in us-west that billing just flagged. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/gpu-reservations?range=30d. If this trend holds we hit commit overage risk for May. Can infra + finance weigh in? cc @ben @sophie

ben: Looking now. Quick summary: hosted prod spike on 2026-05-02 (02:00–06:00 UTC) — avg GPUs used jumped from ~620 -> ~820. If sustained that's ~40 GPUs short vs committed in us-west.

aj: Query I pulled (BigQuery):
```
SELECT date, region, SUM(gpu_hours) AS gpu_hours
FROM billing.hosted_usage
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE()
GROUP BY date, region
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 100
```
Exports cleanly to CSV. Can run an hourly rollup if you want.

sophie: Two practical levers: 1) shift traffic to Dedicated (we currently show ~50 spare GPUs in dedicated-usw) — avoids cloud overage but increases internal cost allocation; 2) request a short-term burst quota from the cloud provider (may be quicker but per-hour cost higher). I'll run a 4-week cost model for both. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

dave: FYI cloud provider has a noisy-neighbor maintenance window in us-west scheduled 2026-05-05 that could reduce spare capacity. Also check cross-region egress and network quotas before enabling eu fallback — egress cost could negate savings.

billing-bot: ALERT: Project redwood-hosted exceeded reserved commit threshold in us-west by 28% on 2026-05-02. Predicted monthly overage = $44,200 (current burn rate).

maria: OK. Plan: Sophie run cost projection assuming a sustained 30% tilt for 4 weeks and compare (dedicated shift vs cloud burst). Ben/Dave please prepare a safe routing fallback (priority: primary-usw -> dedicated-usw -> eu-central async) and check egress caps. Aj refresh the dashboard + push the BQ export to the shared sheet. I'll do a quick sync in 30m to lock decision.

ben: Routing note — I'll add a policy that prefers dedicated pools for requests tagged as "best-effort-burst" and keeps latency SLOs for high-priority routes. Drafting PR now, will ping for review.

sophie: WIP cost sheet: https://sheets.redwood/s/reserv-tilt-2026 (editing). I'll DM finance for a short-term reserve adjustment ask if dedicated shift looks cheaper.

aj: Pushed a dashboard refresh and dropped the CSV to the sheet. Also added hourly heatmap for last 72h.

dave: I'll validate maintenance impact and run a quick egress estimate for eu-central fallback. If egress > $5k/week it's probably not worth it.

maria: Owners: @sophie cost model, @ben routing + PR, @aj exports/dashboard, @dave infra/egress check. Please post updates here in 2 hours. If anyone spots an obvious quick win (e.g., short-lived traffic source we can throttle), call it out. :thumbsup:

ben: ack

sophie: ack, on it

aj: ack

dave: ack
